# John Doe — Software QA Engineer & React Developer

> Personal portfolio of John Doe, a Software QA Engineer and React Developer who
> builds tested, accessible, high-quality web applications. The site is a
> single-page React application presenting statistics, skills, projects,
> professional experience, certifications, services, and testimonials, with a
> validated contact form for inquiries.

This portfolio is a client-side single-page application (React 19 + Vite). All
content lives on the home page and is reachable via in-page anchor links; there
is no backend API and the contact form is validated entirely client-side. The
site supports light and dark themes and respects the user's reduced-motion
preference.

## Sections

- [Home / Hero](https://johndoe.example.com/#home): Introduction, headline role, and primary calls to action (download resume, contact me).
- [About](https://johndoe.example.com/#about): Professional summary, career objective, education, experience, and key achievements.
- [Statistics](https://johndoe.example.com/#statistics): Animated counters summarizing projects completed, years of experience, technologies learned, and happy clients.
- [Skills](https://johndoe.example.com/#skills): Frontend, backend basics, testing, and automation proficiencies shown as circular progress indicators with proficiency levels.
- [Projects](https://johndoe.example.com/#projects): Selected projects with category filtering and text search, technology stacks, features, an image gallery, and links to source code and live demos.
- [Experience](https://johndoe.example.com/#experience): Timeline of education, QA experience, the React learning journey, and certifications, with company and organization logos, technology badges, and key achievements.
- [Certifications](https://johndoe.example.com/#certifications): Industry certifications and professional credentials with issuing organization, issue date, and links to view each credential.
- [Services](https://johndoe.example.com/#services): Website development, React development, frontend development, QA testing, API testing, and automation support.
- [Resume](https://johndoe.example.com/#resume): Actions to download and view the resume.
- [Testimonials](https://johndoe.example.com/#testimonials): Auto-advancing carousel of client and colleague testimonials with photo, star rating, quote, and attribution.
- [Contact](https://johndoe.example.com/#contact): Validated contact form (name, email, subject, message) and direct contact details.

## Resources

- [Resume (PDF)](https://johndoe.example.com/resume.pdf): Downloadable resume document.
